title: 逆U字型自転車ラック
description: 曲げ加工されたステンレス製の単体自転車ラック。保護スリーブと固定ボルト付き。自転車は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A single anchored stainless-steel bicycle hoop with bent corners, protective sleeves and mounting hardware; no bicycle included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
